advisories.title: Next.js HTTP request deserialization can lead to DoS when using insecure React Server Components
Next.js self-hosted applications vulnerable to DoS via Image Optimizer remotePatterns configuration

risk_assessment.attack_surface: local dev or CI when running next directly
risk_assessment.mitigation: ATB ships static web/out assets embedded in the Go binary; production does not run a self-hosted Next.js server
